reading.body:
WinEuropa is a probable mistag, not a data center: an OpenStreetMap point in Sansepolcro, Italy, tagged as one, with zero megawatts recorded and a name that suggests an IT reseller.

The record carries no operator, no website, and no capacity. Its own research note says the name combines "Win" and "Europa," which reads as a regional PC or software sales and support business, and that the tag is filed as probable rather than verified. The verification attempt failed because search quota ran out, so nothing here was confirmed against a company website or Italian business registration.

For AI infrastructure this entry contributes nothing. A facility with no stated power draw cannot be counted toward compute capacity, and a sales office running its own internal IT is a different kind of thing from a colocation or cloud site serving outside customers. The one geographic fact, that it sits 37.6 miles from Perugia's airport, describes a town in Tuscany and not a grid position.

What the data does not cover is the company itself. It cannot say whether WinEuropa operates any servers at all, how large its premises are, or whether a genuine data center exists elsewhere in Sansepolcro under a different name. It shows only that one map tag, reviewed on 2026-09-04, was judged likely wrong and left unresolved.
